title: SR GT 200 Sport
description: The Aprilia SR GT 200 Sport is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Urban Adventure Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 200cc engine generating 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
